input.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and Singapore exclusive jurisdiction with New York law, leaving 28.2's New York County forum as the sole venue.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved governing law to New York, which is our preferred position, and removed the Singapore forum because it directly conflicts with Section 28.2's exclusive New York County jurisdiction. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York
